reviewNotes: HOLD - ACSOM's official pages describe a four-year MD curriculum, two years of basic sciences in Dominica, then clinical clerkships, published annual USD tuition/fees and visa/wellness/financial-aid support. The World Directory record identifies the school as currently operational and lists Doctor of Medicine. Hold because current approval/accreditation status, actual clinical-site contracts and market-specific licensing claims need independent, current verification.
